description: Create gateway package with WorkerRegistry and K8s Endpoints watcher. The registry tracks active workers per group with their health state and endpoints. It watches K8s Endpoints resources to discover worker pod IPs for services named worker-{group}. Includes WorkerState struct with Group, Endpoint, Ready, Replicas, LastRequest, Health fields and HealthStatus enum. Background Watch goroutine polls /healthz on discovered endpoints.
steps: Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase3/engine/internal/gateway/types.go with HealthStatus type (HealthUnknown, HealthHealthy, HealthUnhealthy), WorkerState struct (Group string, Endpoint string, Ready bool, Replicas int, LastRequest time.Time, Health HealthStatus)

Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase3/engine/internal/gateway/registry.go with WorkerRegistry struct containing: mu sync.RWMutex, workers map[string]*WorkerState, k8sClient kubernetes.Interface, namespace string, log observ.Logger. Methods: NewRegistry(k8sClient, namespace, log), GetWorker(group)(*WorkerState,bool), UpdateHealth(group,health), listWorkers()[]string, Close()

Add Watch(ctx context.Context) method to registry that starts a goroutine: 1) Uses k8s.io/client-go informers/cache to watch Endpoints in namespace, 2) For each Endpoints named worker-{group}, extracts pod IPs from subsets, builds endpoint URL as http://worker-{group}.{namespace}.svc:8080, 3) Updates workers map with new state, 4) Starts background health check goroutine that pings /healthz every 10s per worker

Create /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase3/engine/internal/gateway/registry_test.go with unit tests: TestRegistryGetWorker_NotFound returns false for unknown group, TestRegistryGetWorker_Found returns true and correct state, TestRegistryUpdateHealth updates health status correctly, TestRegistryWatch_DiscoveryFromEndpoints (mock K8s client) verifies endpoint discovery
acceptance_criteria: WorkerRegistry.GetWorker returns correct WorkerState for registered groups
WorkerRegistry.Watch discovers endpoints from K8s Endpoints resource
Health check goroutine updates WorkerState.Health based on /healthz response
findings: Implemented WorkerRegistry with K8s informers for Endpoints watching. Added MarkLastRequest method for tracking last dispatched request time. GetWorker returns a copy to prevent callers from mutating internal state. Health check loop runs every 10s and probes /healthz on all registered workers. Tests use k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes/fake for mock K8s client. Cross-FEAT verification passed: go mod tidy, go build ./cmd/engine, go build ./cmd/worker, go test ./... (12 packages pass), go vet ./... all succeed.
